_about: Round 15 (2026-11-25): keep the current effects model and improve around it, Anthony's 'yes' to items 1 to 5: one sound at a time, several takes with an automatic judge, snap to the action, per-sound cleanup and left-right placing, and sound descriptions written the way the model was trained. The run's 'current' tile already uses the new descriptions (item 5); the round 14 winner is added to the page beside it.

variants.label: One sound at a time
variants.why: Each thing that makes a sound (the vacuum, the footsteps) is made on its own from the part of the video where it is heard, and is its own clip in the editor. A sound that runs over several shots is one continuous sound.

variants.label: One sound at a time, best of 3 takes
variants.why: Three takes of every sound. An automatic judge keeps the one closest to its description and marks down takes with stray voices, music, or a key moment that starts at the wrong instant.

variants.label: Snap, clean up and place
variants.why: Key moments slide onto the exact instant of the action, every sound is tidied (rumble out, hiss between hits down, sharper attack), and sounds sit a little left or right to match the picture. Best heard on headphones.

variants.label: Everything together
variants.why: All of the above at once: what the new default would be.
